summary: Returns the schema of a sheet, stored or inferred from its contents.
description: A schema describes the columns: their names, their types and the row the names live in. When `insertSchema` has stored one on the sheet, that is what comes back.

When nothing was stored, the sheet is read and a schema is inferred from the header row and the values below it. The result carries `inferred: true` in that case, so a caller can tell a description that was declared from one that was guessed.
returns: the schema, or `null` when the sheet holds nothing to describe.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is not a sheet.

examples.title: Reading a schema
